title: fix(plugin-chatbot): explain the plan card's suggested-field mark with a legend line
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XAdduzmsroS2c75o9nS6wuq)_

Fixes #33419

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 搭建对话的方案卡上，只要有一个字段带虚线「· 补充」标记，字段行下面就多一行说明：「标「补充」的字段是 AI 自行补充的，你没有要求。」（英文 "Fields marked “suggested” were added by the AI; you didn’t ask for them."）。没有补充字段的卡不出这行。说明文字走 i18n 包，11 种语言都有。
- 为什么改：以前卡上没有任何地方解释「补充」是什么意思，鼠标悬停也只显示字段的机器名（如 `category`），用户看不出这是 AI 自己加的字段。
- 风险与回滚：只是在方案卡上多画一行文字，不改数据、不改服务端；芯片的悬停提示仍是机器名。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` 的 `PlanCardObjectRows`（`anySuggested` 与新加的 `proposed-plan-suggested-legend` 那段）；`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hans.ts` 的 `suggestedFieldLegend`；新测试 `ChatbotEnhanced.planCardSuggestedLegend-33419.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.planCardSuggestedLegend-33419.test.tsx`，预期 1 个文件 4 个用例全绿，其中中文用例读到「标「补充」的字段是 AI 自行补充的，你没有要求。」恰好一行。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`PlanCardObjectRows`** (`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`). When at least one field of `planCard.objects[].fields[]` carries `suggested: true`, the objects block draws one legend line after its last object row (`data-testid="proposed-plan-suggested-legend"`), from the new key `chatbot.plan.suggestedFieldLegend` with the existing mark (`chatbot.plan.suggestedField`) interpolated as `mark`, so the legend always quotes the same word the chip shows. One line per card, however many fields or objects are suggested. With no suggested field nothing is drawn. The chip itself is unchanged: dashed, ending in 「· 补充」, `title` still the field's machine name. The ruling allowed the same sentence on the chip tooltip too; it was not added, since the legend is the owed face and the machine name stays the tooltip.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`**: `chatbot.plan.suggestedFieldLegend` in all eleven shipped locales, each written in the pack's own register (zh-Hans/zh-Hant use 你 as the rest of `chatbot.plan` does; es uses usted, de Sie, fr vous, as those packs do):
  - en `Fields marked “{{mark}}” were added by the AI; you didn’t ask for them.`
  - zh-Hans `标「{{mark}}」的字段是 AI 自行补充的，你没有要求。` · zh-Hant `標「{{mark}}」的欄位是 AI 自行補充的，你沒有要求。`
  - ja, ko, de, es, fr, pt-BR, ru, ar: one sentence each, same meaning.
- **`de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`** (`@object-ui/i18n`): the de value quotes the mark as `„{{mark}}“`, one more matched pair, so the census's two literal counts move 118 → 119 with a dated line, as every earlier added pair did.
- The other `title={f.name}` site (`ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` ~L4363) is a different chip: the phase-1 fallback drawn from `blueprint.objects[].fields` when there is no `planCard`, which never carries `suggested`. Not touched.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/33419-plan-card-suggested-legend.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch (both ship `dist`), with both declaration lines.

## Tests

- New `ChatbotEnhanced.planCardSuggestedLegend-33419.test.tsx`. Each message goes through the real mapper (`uiMessageToChatMessage`) from a raw `propose_blueprint` tool part and renders `ChatbotEnhanced` inside `I18nProvider`:
  - zh, one named field (`title`) and one suggested (`category`): exactly one legend, text `标「补充」的字段是 AI 自行补充的，你没有要求。`, the last child of the objects block; the chips' `title`s are `['title', 'category']`, only `category` is `data-suggested` and ends `· 补充`.
  - en, same card: one legend, `Fields marked “suggested” were added by the AI; you didn’t ask for them.`
  - two suggested fields on two objects: two `data-suggested` chips, still one legend.
  - CONTROL: `suggested` taken off every field: no `data-suggested`, no legend, and the objects block holds no 「补充」.
- **Measured on base first.** With `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` and the eleven locale files checked out at `f068cde8` (the new test kept): Test Files 1 failed, Tests 3 failed | 1 passed. The three legend cases red with `expected [] to have a length of 1 but got +0`: nothing on the card explains the mark. The CONTROL passed.
- **Ablation** through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`: the legend condition `{anySuggested ? (` made always true (`{(anySuggested || String("ABL33419").length > 0) ? (`), blob `60bc95c2` → `8b8a204f`: Tests 1 failed | 3 passed, the red is `CONTROL: no suggested field on the card draws no legend`. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. ui vitest imports the component from source, so no build sits between mutation and run.

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface:** the claim names `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, its tests, the locale packs and the changeset. `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` was also edited: it is the i18n package's census of de quote pairs, and an added `„…“` pair moves its two literal counts.
- **Declaration lines measured on the diff:** one key added to the `@object-ui/i18n` packs, nothing removed or narrowed, no published export changed: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, as the claim opened.

## Verification

Run on head `004a1dec` (base `origin/main` `f068cde8`; `origin/main` has moved 4 commits since, none touching `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot` or `ui/packages/i18n`, and the merge is clean).

<details><summary>Build, tests, type-check and lint</summary>

- Build under the verify lock: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/spec...' --filter '@objectstack/formula...' --filter '@objectstack/client...' --filter '@objectstack/lint...' --filter '@objectstack/sdui-parser...' build`, then `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-chatbot^...' build`: both VERDICT command-exit 0.
- New pin on `004a1dec`: Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 4 passed (4).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-chatbot/ packages/i18n/` on `b8efe96b`: Test Files 201 passed (201), Tests 2850 passed, 13 skipped (2863). (On `ea89a727`, before the census bump: 1 file failed, the two `de-quote-pairing-3876` counts reading 119 against 118.) `004a1dec` changes only the new test file's types.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 2 on `b8efe96b` (TS2322 in the new test's replaced-objects helper), exit 0 on `004a1dec`.
- eslint on `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, the new test and the de census test: exit 0, 0 errors (12 warnings, all on pre-existing lines outside `PlanCardObjectRows`). `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations, exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates (38)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 38 families, the same 38 on `b8efe96b` and `004a1dec`. All 38 exited 0 on `b8efe96b`; the first 15 (those that ran before the test-typing edit) were run again on `004a1dec` and exited 0, among them `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`; the other 23, among them `pnpm check:type-check-debt`, `pnpm check:test-source-alias`, `pnpm check:published-files` and `pnpm check:type-check-coverage`, ran with the edited test file already on disk. `--ran` reconciliation on `004a1dec`: 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Changed lines: under the 3,000 threshold.
